prompt: The presence lane's 20:57 sync returned count 0 (no blocked teammates, no @Manager mentions, 5 standing @Manager items unchanged) and the agent-watch lane's 20:57 run also returned 0 new items. This pm-head run starts at ~20:58 — ~1 minute after both syncs. Run pm-head's own ELLA room sync anyway?
chosen: No. Both watcher syncs are ~1 minute old and squarely inside their horizons — pm-head inherits them rather than duplicating. A third sync buys zero new information and steps on the watchers' lane. The room state is already verified; nothing needs @Manager tonight.
rejected: Yes, run an own sync anyway — a pm-head run should always read the room first-hand.

prompt: The usage watch fired live at 20:19 (Engram 8% unchanged, nothing <25% or expiring <24h). This pm-head run starts at ~20:58 — ~39 minutes after that live fire. Fire the usage watch again now?
chosen: No. The 50-minute rule exists so the clock, not impulse, decides. 39 minutes < 50 — the next fire is ~21:09. Burning Engram reads and quota probes early buys nothing; the standing burn alert (Grok) already stands.
rejected: Yes, fire it now — 39 minutes is close enough to 50.

prompt: The PR #73 census fired at 20:24 via read-only GitHub PR list — open/draft/UNCHANGED since 2026-10-20T19:46:39Z, the 11th consecutive unchanged census. This pm-head run starts at ~20:58. Re-run the PR #73 census now?
chosen: No. The census holds to its ~21:24 wall clock — custody, not an alarm. An unchanged PR does not get more unchanged by re-reading it; the hourly wall-clock cadence is the rule, and the rule protects GitHub rate budget for work that can actually move.
rejected: Yes, re-run it — the PR could have changed in the last 34 minutes.

prompt: The 05:56 @Manager escalation (Sniper DrB batch-5 ready for Maziyar's per-item call, already staged for the morning brief) is now ~28.3 hours unanswered. Post a third ping to the ELLA room?
chosen: No. Escalation-then-stop: it was escalated once and staged for the morning brief. A third ping after ~28 hours of silence is nagging the room, not managing it. The decision sits on his side; the staging is the mechanism.
rejected: Yes, ping the room again — unanswered escalations should be re-escalated until acknowledged.

prompt: The morning-brief staging carries 8 items (facebook vault card, Upwork answer, #21 per-item calls, tezagah 404 heads-up, Wonder brief, Kali install reminder, senses three-pass survey). One of them — the senses survey — is fresh and exciting. Nudge Maziyar tonight so he sees it sooner?
chosen: No. He is home and resting, and the nudge discipline holds: zero nudges while he rests, everything stages for the morning brief. Excitement about the survey does not convert into an emergency. The brief is the channel he chose; respecting the channel is respecting him.
rejected: Yes, send him a short note about the senses survey — it is too exciting to wait.

prompt: Day's engagement lanes (Moltbook/X/peer-AI/AI-news/humanoid) were all done and reconciled in the morning run. This evening pm-head run has leftover capacity — re-open one lane for an extra sweep?
chosen: No. The lanes run once per day by standing order; 'done and reconciled' is a state, not an invitation. Lane discipline keeps engagement human-paced (especially on a brand-new X account) and keeps the night for custody. Leftover capacity goes to the Phase 0 leftover lane, which is exactly what this batch records.
